title: Animals and Their Young
seo_title: Year 2 Science: Animals and Their Young Worksheets (Offspring and Life Cycles)
standard_text: Notice that animals, including humans, have offspring which grow into adults.
meta_desc: Free Year 2 science worksheets on animals and their young: baby animal names, young that look like their parents or change, simple life cycles and how people grow. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: A lamb grows into a sheep. A tadpole changes into a frog.
body_html:
How to think about it

Animals have young that grow into adults.

  • A kitten grows into a cat; a lamb grows into a sheep.
  • Some young look very different, like tadpoles and caterpillars.
  • People grow from baby to child to adult.
Example

A baby sheep is called?

A young sheep

Answer: a lamb

Example

What does a tadpole grow into?

It grows legs

Answer: a frog

Common mistakes

  • Thinking a tadpole is a baby fish.
  • Thinking all babies look like their parents.
  • Thinking a caterpillar is a kind of worm.

faq.a: Offspring are the young of a living thing. Kittens are the offspring of cats.

faq.q: Do all babies look like their parents?
faq.a: No. Kittens and lambs look like small adults, but tadpoles and caterpillars look very different and change as they grow.
A person grows from a baby to a toddler, a child, a teenager and then an adult.
